segments.ja539:1.3: Kaṃ [kiṃ (syā. ka.)] tvaṃ atthavasaṃ ñatvā, evaṃ vāyamase bhusaṃ”.
segments.ja539:4.1: “Anaṇo ñātinaṃ hoti, devānaṃ pitunañca [pituno ca (sī. pī.)] so;
segments.ja539:6.3: Na rakkhe attano pāṇaṃ, jaññā so yadi hāpaye.
segments.ja539:7.3: Payojayanti kammāni, tāni ijjhanti vā na vā.
segments.ja539:8.3: Sannā aññe tarāmahaṃ, tañca passāmi santike.
segments.ja539:9.3: Gacchaṃ pāraṃ samuddassa, kassaṃ [kāsaṃ (sī. pī.)] purisakāriyaṃ”.
segments.ja539:10.1: “Yo tvaṃ evaṃ gate oghe, appameyye mahaṇṇave;
segments.ja539:10.5: So tvaṃ tattheva gacchāhi, yattha te nirato mano”.
segments.ja539:14.1: “Āsīsetheva [āsiṃsetheva (sī. syā. pī.)] puriso, na nibbindeyya paṇḍito;
segments.ja539:14.3: Passāmi vohaṃ attānaṃ, yathā icchiṃ tathā ahu.
segments.ja539:16.3: Passāmi vohaṃ attānaṃ, yathā icchiṃ tathā ahu.
segments.ja539:18.1: “Dukkhūpanītopi naro sapañño, āsaṃ na chindeyya sukhāgamāya;
segments.ja539:18.3: Bahū hi phassā ahitā hitā ca, avitakkitā maccumupabbajanti [maccumuppajjanti (syā.)].
segments.ja539:19.3: Na hi cintāmayā bhogā, itthiyā purisassa vā”.
segments.ja539:20.1: “Aporāṇaṃ [apurāṇaṃ (sī. pī.)] vata bho rājā, sabbabhummo disampati;
segments.ja539:20.3: Nājja nacce [na ca nacce (ka.)] nisāmeti, na gīte kurute mano.
segments.ja539:21.1: “Na mige [mage (ka.)] napi uyyāne, napi haṃse udikkhati;
segments.ja539:22.3: Kassa [kesaṃ (sī. pī.)] nu ajja ārāme, daharā vuddhā ca acchare.
segments.ja539:24.1: “Te chetvā maccuno jālaṃ, tataṃ [tantaṃ (sī. syā. pī.), taṃ taṃ (ka.)] māyāvino daḷaṃ;
segments.ja539:24.3: Chinnālayattā [santālayantā (syā. ka.)] gacchanti, ko tesaṃ gatimāpaye”[nesaṃ gati pāpaye (ka.)].
segments.ja539:25.3: Pahāya pabbajissāmi, taṃ kudāssu [kadāssu (sī. pī.), kadāsu (syā.)] bhavissati.
segments.ja539:38.1: “Kadāhaṃ antepuraṃ [kadā antepuraṃ (sī. pī.)] rammaṃ, vibhattaṃ bhāgaso mitaṃ;
segments.ja539:46.1: [ayaṃ gāthā sī. pī. potthakesu na dissati]“Kadāhaṃ maṇipallaṅke, gonake cittasanthate;
segments.ja539:46.3: Pahāya pabbajissāmi, taṃ kudāssu bhavissati [ayaṃ gāthā sī. pī. potthakesu na dissati].
segments.ja539:74.1: [ayaṃ gāthā sī. pī. potthakesu na dissati]“Kadāhaṃ dhanuggahe ca, sabbālaṅkārabhūsite;
segments.ja539:74.5: Pahāya pabbajissāmi, taṃ kudāssu bhavissati [ayaṃ gāthā sī. pī. potthakesu na dissati].
segments.ja539:76.1: “Kadāhaṃ ariyagaṇe ca, vatavante [vatthavante (sī. syā. pī.)] alaṅkate;
segments.ja539:77.1: [ayaṃ gāthā sī. pī. potthakesu na dissati]“Kadāhaṃ amaccagaṇe ca, sabbālaṅkārabhūsite;
segments.ja539:77.5: Pahāya pabbajissāmi, taṃ kudāssu bhavissati [ayaṃ gāthā sī. pī. potthakesu na dissati].

segments.ja539:117.1: “Kadāhaṃ sabbattha gantvā [sabbahaṃ ṭhānaṃ (sī.), sabbaṇhaṃ gantvā (syā.), sabbāhaṃ ṭhānaṃ (pī.), sabbaṭṭhānaṃ (ka.)], rukkhā rukkhaṃ vanā vanaṃ;
segments.ja539:118.3: Adutiyo gamissāmi [viharissāmi (sī. pī.)], taṃ kudāssu bhavissati.
segments.ja539:119.1: “Kadāhaṃ vīṇaṃ varujjako [vīṇarujjako (syā.), vīṇaṃ virujjako (ka.)], sattatantiṃ manoramaṃ;
segments.ja539:119.3: Cittaṃ ujuṃ karissāmi, taṃ kudāssu bhavissati.
segments.ja539:120.3: Kāmasaññojane checchaṃ [chetvā (ka.)], ye dibbe ye ca mānuse”.
segments.ja539:121.3: Bāhā paggayha pakkanduṃ, kasmā no vijahissasi.

segments.ja539:128.1: “Bhesmā [vesmā (sī.), bhiṃsā (pī.), bhīsā (ka.)] aggisamā jālā, kosā ḍayhanti bhāgaso;
segments.ja539:129.5: Ehi rāja nivattassu, mā tetaṃ vinasā dhanaṃ”[vinassā dhanaṃ (syā. ka.)].
segments.ja539:130.1: “Susukhaṃ vata jīvāma, yesaṃ no natthi kiñcanaṃ;
segments.ja539:130.3: Mithilāya dayhamānāya, na me kiñci adayhatha”.
segments.ja539:131.3: Ehi rāja nivattassu, mā raṭṭhaṃ vinasā idaṃ”.
segments.ja539:132.1: “Susukhaṃ vata jīvāma, yesaṃ no natthi kiñcanaṃ;
segments.ja539:132.3: Raṭṭhe vilumpamānamhi, na [mā (ka.)] me kiñci ahīratha.
segments.ja539:133.1: “Susukhaṃ vata jīvāma, yesaṃ no natthi kiñcanaṃ;
segments.ja539:134.1: “Kimheso mahato ghoso, kā nu gāmeva kīḷiyā [gāme kilīliyā (sī.)];
segments.ja539:134.3: Samaṇa teva [samaṇaññeva (sī. pī.), samaṇatveva (syā.)] pucchāma, kattheso abhisaṭo jano”.
segments.ja539:136.1: “Māssu tiṇṇo amaññittha [amaññittho (sī. syā. pī.)], sarīraṃ dhārayaṃ imaṃ;
segments.ja539:136.3: Atīraṇeyya yamidaṃ [atīraṇeyyamidaṃ kammaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)], bahū hi paripanthayo”.
segments.ja539:139.3: Brāhmaṇa teva [brāhmaṇaññeva (sī.)] pucchāmi, ko nu tvamasi mārisa”.
segments.ja539:140.1: “Nārado iti me nāmaṃ [nāmena (syā. ka.)], kassapo iti maṃ vidū;
segments.ja539:141.3: Yaṃ ūnaṃ [yadūnaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] taṃ paripūrehi, khantiyā upasamena ca.
segments.ja539:143.1: “Bahū hatthī ca asse ca, nagare janapadāni ca;
segments.ja539:143.3: Hitvā janaka pabbajito, kapāle [kapalle (sī. pī.)] ratimajjhagā.
segments.ja539:144.1: “Kacci nu te jānapadā, mittāmaccā ca ñātakā;
segments.ja539:144.3: Dubbhimakaṃsu janaka, kasmā te taṃ aruccatha”.
segments.ja539:145.1: “Na migājina jātucche [jātucca (sī. pī.)], ahaṃ kañci kudācanaṃ;
segments.ja539:145.3: Adhammena jine ñātiṃ, na cāpi ñātayo mamaṃ.
segments.ja539:146.3: Haññare bajjhare cettha, yattha sanno [satto (sī.)] puthujjano;
segments.ja539:147.1: “Ko nu te bhagavā satthā, kassetaṃ vacanaṃ suci;
segments.ja539:147.3: Na hi kappaṃ vā vijjaṃ vā, paccakkhāya rathesabha;
segments.ja539:150.3: Sa migājina maddakkhiṃ, phaliṃ [phalaṃ (sī. pī. ka.)] ambaṃ tirocchadaṃ;
segments.ja539:150.5: Haññamānaṃ [tujjamānaṃ (sī.), tudamānaṃ (syā.), taddamānaṃ (pī.), hatamānaṃ (ka.)] manussehi, phalakāmehi jantubhi.
segments.ja539:151.1: “So khohaṃ taṃ siriṃ hitvā, orohitvā migājina;
segments.ja539:152.1: “Phaliṃ [phalaṃ (sī. pī. ka.)] ambaṃ hataṃ disvā, viddhaṃstaṃ vinaḷīkataṃ;
segments.ja539:152.3: Athekaṃ [athetaṃ (sī. pī.)] itaraṃ ambaṃ, nīlobhāsaṃ manoramaṃ.
segments.ja539:153.3: Amittā no vadhissanti, yathā ambo phalī hato.
segments.ja539:154.5: Phalī ambo aphalo ca, te satthāro ubho mama”.
segments.ja539:156.3: Puttaṃ rajje ṭhapetvāna, atha pacchā pabbajissasi”.
segments.ja539:158.1: “Ehi taṃ anusikkhāmi, yaṃ vākyaṃ mama ruccati;
segments.ja539:158.3: Rajjaṃ tuvaṃ kārayasi [kārayantī (sī. syā. pī.)], pāpaṃ duccaritaṃ bahuṃ;
segments.ja539:158.5: Kāyena vācā manasā, yena gacchasi [kañchisi (sī. pī.)] duggatiṃ.
segments.ja539:160.1: “Yopi catutthe bhattakāle na bhuñje, ajuṭṭhamārīva [ajaddhumārīva (sī.), ajjhuṭṭhamāriva (syā.), ajaddhumāriva (pī.) majjhimanikāye, aṅguttaranikāye ca passitabbaṃ] khudāya miyye;
segments.ja539:160.3: Na tveva piṇḍaṃ luḷitaṃ anariyaṃ, kulaputtarūpo sappuriso na seve;
segments.ja539:160.5: Tayidaṃ na sādhu tayidaṃ na suṭṭhu, sunakhucchiṭṭhakaṃ janaka bhuñjase tuvaṃ”.
segments.ja539:161.1: “Na cāpi me sīvali so abhakkho, yaṃ hoti cattaṃ gihino sunassa vā;
segments.ja539:161.3: Ye keci bhogā idha dhammaladdhā, sabbo so bhakkho anavayoti [anavajjoti (sī. pī.)] vutto”.
segments.ja539:162.3: Kasmā te eko bhujo janati, eko te na janatī bhujo”.
segments.ja539:163.1: “Imasmiṃ me samaṇa hatthe, paṭimukkā dunīvarā [dunīdhurā (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja539:163.3: Saṅghātā [saṃghaṭṭā (syā. ka.)] jāyate saddo, dutiyasseva sā gati.
segments.ja539:164.1: “Imasmiṃ me samaṇa hatthe, paṭimukko ekanīvaro [ekanīdhuro (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja539:164.3: So adutiyo na janati, munibhūtova tiṭṭhati.
segments.ja539:166.1: “Suṇāsi sīvali kathā [gāthā (sī. syā. pī.)], kumāriyā paveditā;
segments.ja539:166.3: Pesiyā [pessiyā (sī. pī.)] maṃ garahittho, dutiyasseva sā gati.
segments.ja539:167.3: Tesaṃ tvaṃ ekaṃ gaṇhāhi, ahamekaṃ punāparaṃ.
segments.ja539:168.1: “Māvaca [neva (sī. pī.), mā ca (syā. ka.)] maṃ tvaṃ pati meti, nāhaṃ [māhaṃ (sī. pī.)] bhariyāti vā puna”;
segments.ja539:169.3: Tatrā ca so usukāro,(ekaṃ daṇḍaṃ ujuṃ kataṃ;)[() natthi bahūsu]
segments.ja539:170.1: “Evaṃ no sādhu passasi, usukāra suṇohi me;
segments.ja539:171.3: Asampatvā paramaṃ [paraṃ (sī. pī.)] liṅgaṃ, nujubhāvāya kappati.
segments.ja539:174.1: “Suṇāsi sīvali kathā [gāthā (sī. syā. pī.)], usukārena veditā;
segments.ja539:174.3: Pesiyā maṃ garahittho, dutiyasseva sā gati.
segments.ja539:175.3: Tesaṃ tvaṃ ekaṃ gaṇhāhi, ahamekaṃ punāparaṃ.
segments.ja539:176.1: “Māvaca maṃ tvaṃ pati meti, nāhaṃ bhariyāti vā puna”;
